scope: P6 enemy snapshot/restore boundary and existing candidate registry, including real three-Stage and App consumers
mode: Read-only source/immutable Git comparison. No Godot execution; no production/test/asset edits.

checks.name: actual_consumers
checks.detail: Plains and environment call region_snapshot(); forest calls region_snapshot(false,true). All three old enemy dictionary implementations were removed. App invokes behavior.restore_region_state after encounter binding and authored geometry setup.

checks.name: snapshot_fields_order_types
checks.detail: Plains/environment retain health,position,state,state_time,cooldown,serial,locked_direction,attack_goal,attack_origin,home,direction in that order. Forest retains its eight-field subset omitting attack vectors. Outer fields are String keys; forest depth_state remains the original dot-appended StringName. efb202db fixes the interim dot-insertion regression; acceptance covers the corrected version.

checks.name: local_position_and_defaults
checks.detail: All eight enemy scenes bind Actor.motor to NodePath(..); motor.position equals the original enemies[i].position. Health, scalar and no-attack vector defaults are unchanged. Snapshot does not reset/advance/cancel actor state or alter epoch.

checks.name: restore_assignment_order
checks.detail: Independent normalization comparison found old App common assignments identical to EnemyAttackBehavior.restore_region_state after removing owner qualification: state, state_time, cooldown, serial, optional home, optional locked_direction/attack_goal/attack_origin, brain.direction, then depth validation.

checks.name: weaver_rejection_partial_writes
checks.detail: Weaver validates depth fields against already-applied outer phase/time/cooldown/serial/home and authored strands. Failure intentionally leaves prior outer writes as the original App did, then returns false to the unchanged abandon-run path. No invented atomic rollback or geometry-from-save was introduced.

checks.name: crossbranch_depth_authority
checks.detail: Override skips all generic outer assignments, including home/facing, just as old App special-casing did. Actual depth validation/application is unchanged, including geometry validation before mutation and actor-epoch rebinding. Missing required depth remains rejected by App/Stage; the low-level optional extension method retains its historical no-op when absent.

checks.name: surrounding_lifecycle
checks.detail: Stage still owns initial position and restore_instance_health before App behavior restore. Shore/transfer/strand/line setup occurs before restore; attack limits, presentation synchronization and contact attachment follow it. Snapshot extraction does not move boss/mechanism/drop/corpse state authority.

checks.name: candidate_single_authority
checks.detail: Existing CANDIDATES mapping now supplies Factory candidate_recipe behavior rather than a duplicate behavior entry in CANDIDATE_RECIPES. Registry tables, rejection, scene/definition/strategy selection are unchanged. Actual Lab and Studio consumers still use EnemyFactory.create_candidate. Lab/review vs Studio authored widths, movement and guard flags remain intentionally distinct.

verification.native_reported_by_root: Existing enemy_region_state_runner completed 61 checks, 0 failures. This report does not convert that into a reviewer-run claim.
verification.limits: The new native runner is an explicit real-Actor fixture, not a natural three-Stage/App playthrough. Consumer tracing here is static. Overall formal cleanup leak was bisected by root to P3 and remains a separate integration blocker; this review does not approve release.
